values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/littlebrevort ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Little Brevort Lake-North State Forest Campground, Mackinac: 20 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Boat launch on the lake near the picnic area (no-wake rules); carry-in access by the grassy lakeside picnic area.

values.note: 20 sites 'for tents and small trailers' (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no maximum length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/littlebrevort ('The campground features 20 sites for tents and small trailers.'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + amenity table (20 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground on the northwest side of Little Brevort Lake, beside a state-designated natural area and the Hiawatha National Forest, 2.3 mi E of Brevort via Worth and Ozark roads (Mackinac County); managed by Straits State Park. Grassy lakeside picnic area with two tables; the 2.25-mile Switchback Ridge Pathway (dunes and thick forest) starts at the campground. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 20 tent/small-trailer sites (confirmed), $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, boat launch, first-come only, 15-day maximum (all confirmed). Cleared max_rig_ft 40 (derived from the note's 'some rated up to ~40 ft', which no DNR page states). Season (open all year) already manual and matches. Phone 906-643-8620 (Straits SP) matches; DNR's directions point 46.019775,-85.017333 is ~40 m from the pin. Not equestrian (type 'rustic'). The DNR page and the amenity table describe only this North campground (see the flag on 3710). Note trimmed of field restatements.
